answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 45947 Country: India Title: Walimah Question: It is necessary that to have sex with wife in the first night of marriage? I heard that to have sex with newly wife otherwise the walimah will be haram and not according to sunnah. Is it right or wrong? Answer ID: 45947 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 874/677/H=1434) What you have heard regarding the unlawfulness of walimah is totally wrong. Walimah is not haram rather it is valid without any doubt according to one opinion. However, it is better to perform walimah after the spouse meet in privacy. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
